# timeanddate.com

> A comprehensive global timekeeping resource providing real-time world clock data, timezone information, and time-related tools for worldwide cities.

timeanddate.com specializes in accurate time information and timezone management across major cities globally. The site offers both interactive world clocks and embeddable widgets for websites, serving users who need to coordinate time across different regions or track current time in multiple locations.

## Key Topics

- world clock
- time zones
- current time
- global cities
- timezone support
- DST (Daylight Saving Time)
- city comparison
- local times
- clock widgets
- embedded clocks
- timezone reference
- worldwide time
- New York
- London
- Tokyo

## World Clock & Time Tools

- [The World Clock — Worldwide](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock): World clock displaying current time across major cities with timezone and DST support.
- [The World Clock (extended version)](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/full.html): Extended world clock with comprehensive city listings, weather, sunrise/sunset data.

## Developer Resources

- [Free Clocks for Your Website](https://www.timeanddate.com/clocks/free.html): Guide to creating and embedding customizable clock widgets on websites.
